faqs.title: How long are the tours?
faqs.content: Yes, you can try us for free for 30 days. If you want, we’ll provide you with a free, personalized 30-minute onboarding call to get you up and running as soon as possible.

faqs.title: Where do tours start?
faqs.content: Finding the exact departure point for your tour is straightforward, as all necessary details are finalized the moment your booking is confirmed. The precise meeting location, complete with a direct Google Maps link and structural directions, is sent straight to your confirmation email and saved in your customer dashboard. Because our itineraries operate on a strict timetable to ensure you get the absolute most out of the experience, we highly recommend arriving at least 15 minutes before your scheduled departure time. Once you reach the designated coordinates, simply look for your local guide, who will be easily identifiable by the distinct branded apparel or sign specified on your voucher, ready to begin your journey.

faqs.title: What should I wear?
faqs.content: For the best experience, we highly recommend dressing in comfortable, weather-appropriate smart layers and pairing them with sturdy, closed-toe walking shoes. Because this experience keeps you moving and conditions can change throughout the day, wearing a breathable base layer with a light jacket or sweater you can easily remove or tie away ensures you stay perfectly comfortable from start to finish. There is no need for formal attire - just choose practical, relaxed clothing that allows you to move freely, and don't forget to pack a pair of sunglasses, a hat, or a compact umbrella so you are completely prepared for whatever the day brings.

faqs.title: Free cancellation?
faqs.content: Yes, you can cancel your booking completely free of charge up to 24 hours before the experience starts for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are non-refundable, so if your plans change, just make sure to update or cancel your reservation through your account dashboard before that 24-hour window begins.
